title: rubus × hisautsii
intro: Rubus × hisautsii, commonly known as Japanese wine raspberry or Hisa-utsii raspberry, is a hybrid species of raspberry that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in protecting against chronic diseases and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Rubus × hisautsii are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-cancer properties, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are found in its leaves, stems, and fruits.
